title: SDK backpressure, idempotency, and retry ergonomics for streaming clients
creator: Aisha Khatri
acceptance_criteria: RFC accepted by runtime and API teams and merged into design-docs
Exception classes implemented in Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs with matching names and documented fields
SDK unit tests validate header parsing and Retry-After propagation
Integration tests exercising resume_token flows pass in CI
Sample snippets added to SDK docs and a quickstart demonstrating safe resume and idempotency
notes: Design tradeoff: automatic resume is opt-in because auto-resume can duplicate side-effects in downstream systems; we prefer to give developers control.
We chose X-RI-Backpressure header over enumerating many 429 variants to keep server surface small and make client parsing deterministic.
Idempotency key generation helper should be intentionally simple (UUID) and documented as best-effort; persistence of keys is left to application layer where necessary.
Consider later adding a durable resume store in Console for long-lived sessions (future work).
